autoTeamHint: Let the coordinator choose roles for your goal
allowSupplement: Allow the coordinator to add members
oneRunOnly: For this run only; the template stays unchanged
manageOnWeb: Edit agents and team templates on the web. On a phone you can start a run, follow progress, answer questions, pause and cancel.
supplementEnabled: The coordinator may add members within the approved scope
selectMember: Select a member to inspect their role, model and execution
noTasks: The coordinator has not created tasks yet
noArtifacts: No file artifacts yet. Text results appear in task attempts.
noRun: This conversation has no team run yet
backToTeam: Back to team chat · Member conversation is read only
capacityWait: Waiting for an execution slot. Work remains queued and will retry automatically.

notice.DRIVER_BACKPRESSURE: Execution capacity was full. The accepted work remains queued for an automatic retry.
notice.TEAM_PROGRESS_STALLED: No task or artifact progress was recorded within the time limit. Review the team's current work.
notice.TEAM_NO_EXECUTABLE_WORK: Required work remains, but no task can advance. The coordinator has been notified.
notice.TEAM_DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED: An upstream task prevents later work from starting. Review retry, replacement or cancellation.
notice.TEAM_REPEATED_EXCHANGE: Members exchanged repeated messages without task progress. Check for duplicated work.
notice.OWNER_GRANT_UPDATED: The owner updated permissions or execution limits.
notice.OWNER_MESSAGE_ACCEPTED: The owner added instructions for the coordinator.
notice.WORKSPACE_SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE: The workspace snapshot could not be captured. File changes for this team are unavailable.

reason.agent_wall_time_exceeded: An Agent reached its execution time limit. Review the interrupted task before retrying.
reason.coordinator_errors: The coordinator failed three consecutive turns. Review the model service before resuming.
reason.paid_price_bound_exceeded: Reported media cost exceeded the verified bound. Reconcile the retained reservation before continuing.
reason.budget_exceeded: This run was paused by a legacy team budget. Resume to continue using account credits.
reason.stalled: The team cannot make progress. Inspect its tasks and messages.
reason.unpriced_model_usage: Model usage has not been priced. Reconcile its cost before continuing.
reason.model_bound_unavailable: This model needs a verified price and provider context limit before the team can continue.
reason.insufficient_credits: The account has insufficient credits. Add credits, then resume.
reason.model_unpriced: This model has no verified credit price. Select a priced model to continue.

rootOnlyTools: Some required tools cannot be delegated. This skill may be limited.
allowedModels: Allowed models · empty means all available
agentTimeLimitHint: Applies to each task attempt, including waits. Trials and coordinators use a limit per turn. Reaching the limit pauses the team for review.
toolCategoriesHint: Checked categories are permitted. Core and skill-required categories stay enabled; uncheck other categories to restrict execution.
generationOptionsHint: Supports max_output_tokens: a positive integer limit that includes reasoning tokens. Other options are rejected.
name: Name
archiveHint: This definition will no longer be available for new runs. Existing runs and version history are kept.
emptyAgentsHint: Create a role through chat or add one manually.
emptyTemplatesHint: Save a roster here, or save a successful run as a template.
emptyRuns: No team runs yet. Choose Team mode in a conversation to begin.
latestVersion: Latest published version at run start
supplementHint: When unchecked, only this roster is used. With an empty roster, let the coordinator choose members. You can change this for each run.
emptyRosterError: Add a member or allow the coordinator to choose members.
maxConcurrent: Members working at the same time
memberCapabilities: Models, skills and tools members can use
allowTemporary: Allow temporary Agents for this run
readonlyDefinition: This definition is read only. Duplicate it from the library to make changes.
trialHint: Fill in the role and start a trial. Changes apply when you start again.
optimizePrompt: Improve clarity, specificity and boundaries while preserving the purpose and language.
generateHint: Describe the role you need. Review the generated draft before publishing.
runTemplateHint: Choose a project, then describe your goal in the new conversation. You will confirm the roster before it starts.
chatCreateHint: Choose a project and describe the Agent you need in a conversation.
chatCreatePrompt: Help me create a reusable Agent. Ask about its purpose and then propose a draft with agent_manage for my review.
featureUnavailable: Agent teams are not enabled in this workspace.
libraryHint: Create reusable roles, save team rosters, and follow their work.
missingSkillTools: Tools mentioned by {{skill}} but not granted: {{tools}}
saveMemberHint: Save this frozen configuration as a draft. Review and enable it in your Agent library.
saveTemplateHint: Choose members to reuse. Temporary roles will be added to your library, and the fixed team template will be enabled.
rosterGraphHint: Team members and their task assignments and messages. Select a member or a numbered link for details.
needsAttention: Needs attention — open the team to inspect the affected tasks.
deleteRunHint: Delete “{{title}}”, its root conversation, member conversations and team history? Saved Agents, templates and billing records will remain.
usageIncomplete: {{count}} usage records are pending or unpriced; this total is incomplete.
usageSource: From the same usage ledger as billing, limited to this run's time and members. Unknown cost is not treated as free.
mcpExplicit: Only selected services are delegated. Tool patterns are intersected with the team run’s approved scope.
mcpDisabled: MCP delegation is currently disabled in this workspace.
mcpUnavailable: The latest service catalogue is unavailable. Existing selections are preserved and checked again during execution.
mcpEmpty: No MCP services are currently available.
mcpPatternHint: One tool name or pattern per line, such as search_*. Use resource:URI for resources; * includes all tools and resources in this service.
mcpChooseTools: Choose specific tools or resources from the current catalogue
mcpAddName: Add a service that is not currently connected
artifactUnavailable: This file is no longer available.
agentCreatedAutomatically: “{{name}}” was created and enabled using your low-risk Agent preference.
agentCreationUndone: “{{name}}” is a draft again. Runs already started keep their saved version.
unsupportedReasoning: This model does not support the saved reasoning level. Choose the default or an available level.
operationScopesHint: Applies only to selected tools and requires confirmation at start or amendment. Use the required path or command; * broadens the scope.
editGrantHint: Update tool permissions and execution limits. Resume a paused team separately after saving.
grantSaved: Changes saved. A paused team remains paused; close this dialog to resume it.
costCategoryHint: Each charge belongs to one category. Work after a nudge and repeated attempts count as rework. Unknown prices remain visible; historical usage without attribution is not estimated.
versionNoChanges: These versions have the same configuration
versionOnlyOne: Only one version is available. Create another version to compare changes.
paidAuthorizationHint: Authorize paid tools, e.g. {"image_gen":{"authorized":true}}. Usage is charged to the account credit balance.
inlineConfigurationHint: This role configuration is saved with the team template and used for each run. It has no Agent library version.
coreToolsHint: Every Agent includes file access, search, command execution, image viewing and file delivery. These cannot be deselected. Operations still follow permissions and environment availability.
skillDependenciesHint: Selecting a skill automatically selects and locks its required tools and MCP services. Deselect the skill to adjust those options.
discoverSkillsHint: All accessible supports on-demand discovery. Choose specific skills to configure their required tools and services automatically.
unavailableRequiredTools: This Agent cannot use these required tools, so this configuration cannot be enabled: {{tools}}. Deselect the dependent skill or use it in a supported root chat.
